g.title: aeris10_system_block_diagram
g.text: Drawing ID: SYS-01 Revision: A Date: 2026-10-09 Status: SOURCE-DERIVED (CAD + firmware + docs); antenna and host CONCEPTUAL

Source: 4_Schematics and Boards Layout/4_6_Schematics/{MainBoard/RADAR_Main_Board.sch, PowerBoard/PowerBoard.sch, FrequencySynthesizerBoard/Clocks_Freq_Synth_board.sch, PowerAmplifierBoard/RF_PA.sch}; 9_Firmware/9_1_Microcontroller/9_1_3_C_Cpp_Code/main.{h,cpp}; 9_Firmware/9_1_Microcontroller/9_1_1_C_Cpp_Libraries/adf4382a_manager.h; 9_Firmware/9_2_FPGA/radar_system_top.v; 3_Power Management/Power Management V6.xlsx; 2_Functional Diagram & Interconnection Matrices/RADAR_V6.drawio; README.md; docs/SYSTEM/BLOCK_DIAGRAM.md
Legend: solid border = confirmed in schematic | dashed border = documented only (no CAD) | red = open conflict (K1..K8) | grey edge = power | blue edge = control/data | black edge = RF/IF/clock

g.title: cluster_host
g.text: Host computer (no hardware specification in repository)

g.title: cluster_pwr
g.text: Power Supply Board - PowerBoard.sch (EAGLE 9.6.2) / .brd 7.4.0, 280 x 300 mm, 2 Cu (docs/PCB/POWER_SUPPLY.md)

g.title: cluster_syn
g.text: Frequency Synthesizer Board - Clocks_Freq_Synth_board.sch/.brd (EAGLE 9.6.2), 100 x 100 mm, 6 Cu, routed (docs/PCB/FREQUENCY_SYNTHESIZER.md)

g.title: cluster_main
g.text: Main Board - RADAR_Main_Board.sch/.brd (EAGLE 7.4.0), 260 x 300 mm, 10 Cu, 2390 airwires (docs/PCB/MAIN_BOARD.md)

g.title: cluster_main_pabias
g.text: RF PA bias/monitor (sheet 'RF POWER AMPLIFIER BIAS')

g.title: cluster_pa
g.text: RF Power Amplifier Board x16 (README.md:80; CAD = 1 board) - RF_PA.sch/.brd (EAGLE 9.6.2), 35 x 60 mm, 4 Cu, routed (docs/PCB/RF_PA.md)

g.title: cluster_ant
g.text: Antenna assembly - NO CAD in repository (K8)

g.title: cluster_per
g.text: Off-board peripherals (headers on Main Board; module part numbers from xlsx/firmware only)

g.title: gui
g.text: GUI_V6.py (FT601 via pyftdi, VID 0x0403 PID 0x6030/0x6031, GUI_V6.py:33-121)

g.title: syn_conn
g.text: JP1 PINHD-2X6 (AD9523 SPI + ctrl) JP2 PINHD-2X7 (ADF4382 SPI + ctrl)
J3/J4 CJT (OUT4/OUT5 diff.) J5 OUT10 'DAC' J6 OUT11 'FPGA=DAC'
J7 OUT6 'FPGA SYS. CLOCK' J8 OUT7 'TEST' J13 PLL_OUT J2/J9 MUXOUT
X10 +3V3_XO X11 +3V3_CLOCK X12 +1V8_CLOCK X13 +3V3_LO_1 X14 +3V3_LO_2 X15 +5V0_LO

g.title: main_rails
g.text: Rail inputs (Molex 22-23-2021): X8 +1V0_FPGA, X10 +1V8_FPGA, X16 +3V3_FPGA, X24 +3V3,

g.title: syn_osc
g.text: X6 CVHD-950-50.000 VCXO -> net VCXO_OUT -> IC1.OSC_IN
(part values vs. net names vs. xlsx/firmware 100 MHz: CONFLICT)

g.title: syn_ad9523
g.text: REF_SEL -> REFB (main.cpp:1070); PLL2 VCO 3.6 GHz, N=36 (main.cpp:944-946)
OUT0/1 300 MHz -> ADF4382 REF; OUT4/5 400 MHz; OUT6 100 MHz;
OUT7 20 MHz; OUT8/9 60 MHz SYNC; OUT10/11 120 MHz (main.cpp:970-1028)

g.title: syn_lotx
g.text: RFOUT1 -> U2 MTX2-143+ -> U4 ATS1005 -3 dB -> J10 'LO TX'
RFOUT2 -> U3 -> U5 -> J1 'AUX. LO TX'

g.title: syn_lorx
g.text: RFOUT1 -> U7 MTX2-143+ -> U8 ATS1005 -> J11 'LO RX'
RFOUT2 -> U9 -> U10 -> J12 ('AUX. LO RX' by elimination - UNVERIFIED)

g.title: syn_lotx->syn_conn
g.text: J10 LO TX, J1 AUX. LO TX, J9 MUXOUT

g.title: syn_lorx->syn_conn
g.text: J11 LO RX, J12, J2 MUXOUT

g.title: main_sma
g.text: J22 (RX LO in, -> U13.LO), J23 (TX LO in, -> U5.LO)
J1 FPGA_SYS_CLOCK, J18 FPGA_DAC_CLOCK, J20 DAC_CLOCK (SMA)

g.title: syn_conn->main_sma
g.text: coax: J7->J1 100 MHz, J4->J19 400 MHz, J3->J21 400 MHz,
J10->J23 LO TX, J11->J22 LO RX (cables not in CAD)

g.title: main_stm
g.text: XTAL1 NX3225GD-8MHZ HSE (firmware assumes 25 MHz: K2)
SPI1 PA5/6/7 -> FPGA; SPI4 PE2/5/6 -> JP1/JP13
I2C1 PB6/7 -> DAC5578; I2C2 PF0/1 -> ADS7830; I2C3 PA8/PC9 -> JP7/JP18
UART5 PC12/PD2 -> JP8; USART3 PB10/11 -> JP17
USB-FS PA11/PA12 -> X53; 15x EN_* PE7-PE15, PG0-PG5 -> SV1

g.title: main_fpga
g.text: bank 14: ADC LVDS D0..7, DCO, OR, FPGA_ADC_CLOCK
bank 15: DAC_0..7, DIG_0..7, SPI1 3V3, FPGA_SYS_CLOCK, FPGA_DAC_CLOCK, MIX_*_EN

g.title: main_hdr
g.text: JP9 1x4 stepper JP4 1x3 EN/DIS_COOLING JP10 1x3 EN/DIS_RFPA_VDD
JP5, JP6, JP11, JP12, JP14, JP15, JP16, JP19 1x3 analog (+3V3_AN4_F)

g.title: main_pabias
g.text: U10, U88, U89 ADS7830 (I2C2; PA Idq + 8x TMP37)
X3, X38..X52 Molex 3-pin (GND, INA IN+, INA IN-)

g.title: main_dac
g.text: CLOCK <- J20 DAC_CLOCK (120 MHz per main.cpp:1019)
IOUTA/B -> LC network L22/L25/L26/L27 107.3 nH, C127/C59 32.8 pF

g.title: main_sw17
g.text: VCTRL = M3S_VCTRL (FPGA IO_L24N_T3_RS0_15, shared with RF_SW_1..16)

g.title: main_adar
g.text: RF_IO_n <-> U16 PORT_n; TX1..4 / RX1..4 <-> ADTR1107
SPI 1.8 V from U42 bank 34 (STM32_SCLK/MOSI/MISO_1V8, ADAR_n_CS_1V8)
TR, TX_LOAD, RX_LOAD from U42; TR_SW_POS_n -> ADTR CTRL_SW

g.title: main_sw16
g.text: RFC <- ADTR ANT; RFOUT1 -> SMA Ja; RFOUT2 -> SMA Jb

g.title: pa_22v
g.text: xlsx row 59: VD 22 V, 2000 mA x16
NO 22 V rail on Power Board (Vin 12-17 V) -> K4
switched by EN/DIS_RFPA_VDD (JP10, PD6): switch hardware NOT IN CAD

g.title: per_imu
g.text: I2C3 via JP7 / JP18; MAG_DRDY PC6, ACC_INT PC7, GYR_INT PC8

g.title: per_temp
g.text: JP5, JP6, JP11, JP12, JP14, JP15, JP16, JP19 -> ADS7830

g.title: per_step
g.text: STEPPER_CW+ PD4 / STEPPER_CLK+ PD5 via JP9

g.title: main_ifamp
g.text: U8 AD8352 -> U4 AD8352 IF amplifiers (cascade)
U4 VOP/VON -> C44/C45 -> R13/R1 24 R -> U1 VIN+/VIN-

g.title: main_adc
g.text: CLK+/- <- J21 (CJT) via C1/C2 0.1 uF, R173 100 R
D0..7 +/-, DCO +/-, OR +/- LVDS -> U42 bank 14

g.title: main_sma->main_fpga
g.text: J1 FPGA_SYS_CLOCK, J18 FPGA_DAC_CLOCK, J19 FPGA_ADC_CLOCK_P/N, JP20

g.title: pa_qpa
g.text: J1 SMA 'RFIN' (net N$2) -> RFIN; RFOUT -> J2 SMA 'RFOUT' (net N$8)
VD1/VD2 = VIN_M (after R10 WSL2816 5 mR shunt from VD)
X3 Molex 3-pin: VD, VIN_M, GND ('CURRENT SENSOR' silk)

g.title: main_sma->pa_qpa
g.text: 16x SMA coax to PA J1 RFIN / from J2 RFOUT
(which J of each pair = TX/RX: UNVERIFIED)

g.title: ant
g.text: Antenna array, 16 element feeds (one per ADTR1107/RF_SW)
feed network / element-to-port mapping: NOT DOCUMENTED
